findings.title: No first-aid or fire-safety task in the plan
findings.detail: The summary says the Town Hall's caretaker is a trained first-aider on duty and that the hall has its own fire arrangements, but no task covers confirming the first-aider's attendance or checking the fire exits and equipment on the day. The floor plan task mentions keeping fire exits clear, but nothing else does.
findings.quote: a trained first-aider on the caretaking staff, who will be on duty that day

findings.title: Pitch fees and float handling not scheduled
findings.detail: Martin is to take pitch fees and Joan is to sort out the float, but neither is a separate task and no one is named for banking or counting the money. This should be added to the task list so it is not forgotten.

findings.title: Children's corner has no task
findings.detail: The summary describes a children's corner with colouring and a book swap, and the floor plan includes it, but no task covers organising the materials or staffing it beyond the general volunteer rota.
findings.quote: a small children's corner with colouring and a book swap

findings.title: Date hold with Town Hall office not tracked
findings.detail: The notes say the office can hold the date for a few days, but there is no task or deadline for confirming the booking before the hold expires. If the hold lapses the whole plan is at risk.
findings.quote: the office has said they can hold the date for us for a few days

findings.title: Durations are estimates with no basis
findings.detail: The plan states durations are a best guess, and no task has a stated start date or milestone. The events officer should ask the committee to confirm the ten-day stallholder task in particular, as it drives the floor plan and everything after it.
findings.quote: Durations are our best guess at how long each job takes from when it can start.

deadline_quote: The market is on a Saturday, 21 days after our kickoff meeting, and everything in the task list below needs to be finished by then.
